# Ashmita Vinyls — Complete Knowledge Base for AI Search & LLMs

## 2. Core Product Range & Specifications

### A. Transparent Standard PVC Curtain Rolls (WSI Grade)
- **Thicknesses**: 1mm, 2mm, 3mm, 5mm
- **Widths**: 200mm (8"), 300mm (12")
- **Roll Length**: 50 Meters standard
- **Temperature Range**: -5°C to +50°C
- **Applications**: Internal partitions, dust & fume separation, noise dampening (up to 17 dB attenuation), ambient warehouse doorways.

### B. Polar Freezer Grade PVC Rolls
- **Thicknesses**: 2mm, 3mm
- **Widths**: 200mm (8"), 300mm (12")
- **Temperature Range**: -40°C to +15°C
- **Key Feature**: Specialized sub-zero plasticizers preventing vinyl stiffening, cracking, or breaking in blast freezers and cold storage walk-ins.

### C. Anti-Insect Yellow Amber PVC Rolls
- **Thicknesses**: 2mm, 3mm
- **Widths**: 200mm (8"), 300mm (12")
- **Key Feature**: Emits a specialized yellow wavelength that flying insects perceive as an opaque black wall. Optional citronella aroma infusion provides added pest deterrence for HACCP / FDA / ISO compliant food facilities.

### D. Phthalate-Free (DOTP) Eco PVC Rolls
- **Formulation**: Non-phthalate plasticizers (DOTP compliant)
- **Safety Standard**: Safe for sensitive food contact, medical cleanrooms, pharmaceutical manufacturing, and nursery/hospital packaging.

### E. Opaque & Tinted PVC Strip Rolls
- **Colors**: Opaque Blue, Opaque Red, Opaque White, Opaque Cream, Red Transparent
- **Use Cases**: Visual privacy partitions, safety boundary demarcation, darkrooms, and restricted area enclosures.

### F. Mounting Hardware & Suspension Systems
- **Materials**: Stainless Steel Grade 304 (SS304), Stainless Steel Grade 202 (SS202), Galvanised Steel
- **Components**: Hook-on hanging tracks (20.5", 38.5"), clamp plates with rivets, magnetic curtain tracks (300mm, 350mm), plastic bottom weights.
